# Battle.net RPC protobuf messages, generated by hand-written protoc commands into the
# bnetproto static library. Used by both the bot client code and, later, bnetserver.

set(PROTO_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
set(PROTO_FILES
  ${PROTO_DIR}/rpc_types.proto
  ${PROTO_DIR}/entity_types.proto
  ${PROTO_DIR}/content_handle_types.proto
  ${PROTO_DIR}/account_types.proto
  ${PROTO_DIR}/account_service.proto
  ${PROTO_DIR}/attribute_types.proto
  ${PROTO_DIR}/authentication_service.proto
  ${PROTO_DIR}/connection_service.proto
  ${PROTO_DIR}/game_utilities_types.proto
  ${PROTO_DIR}/game_utilities_service.proto
  ${PROTO_DIR}/challenge_service.proto
  ${PROTO_DIR}/field_options.proto
  ${PROTO_DIR}/message_options.proto
  ${PROTO_DIR}/method_options.proto
  ${PROTO_DIR}/range.proto
  ${PROTO_DIR}/routing.proto
  ${PROTO_DIR}/service_options.proto
  ${PROTO_DIR}/login.proto
  ${PROTO_DIR}/realmlist.proto
  ${PROTO_DIR}/semantic_version.proto
  ${PROTO_DIR}/register_method_types.proto
)

# Hand-written protoc invocations: dep/protobuf's vendored 2.6.1 is used instead of
# find_package(Protobuf).
set(PROTO_GENERATED_FILES)
foreach(PROTO_FILE ${PROTO_FILES})
  get_filename_component(PROTO_NAME ${PROTO_FILE} NAME_WE)
  set(PROTO_PB_CC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${PROTO_NAME}.pb.cc)
  set(PROTO_PB_H ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${PROTO_NAME}.pb.h)
  add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT ${PROTO_PB_CC} ${PROTO_PB_H}
    COMMAND protoc -I${PROTO_DIR} -I${PROTOBUF_SRC_DIR} --cpp_out=${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR} ${PROTO_FILE}
    DEPENDS ${PROTO_FILE} protoc
    COMMENT "Generating ${PROTO_NAME}.pb.cc/.h"
    VERBATIM
  )
  list(APPEND PROTO_GENERATED_FILES ${PROTO_PB_CC} ${PROTO_PB_H})
endforeach()

add_library(bnetproto STATIC ${PROTO_GENERATED_FILES})

# Generated code, not ours -- suppressed the same way dep/protobuf suppresses warnings on the
# vendored protobuf runtime/protoc itself (std::iterator deprecation under C++17+, etc.).
if (MSVC)
  target_compile_options(bnetproto PRIVATE /w)
else()
  target_compile_options(bnetproto PRIVATE -w)
endif()

target_include_directories(bnetproto PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR})
target_link_libraries(bnetproto PUBLIC protobuf)

set_target_properties(bnetproto PROPERTIES FOLDER "Game Libs")
